properties.description: Built 2026-10-23, PR A2, dec:idea-a-source-says-what-kind-of-support-it-gives option (c) plus the "named, not read" marking. Artifact `not_read: true` (add_artifact): a DOCUMENTS from it takes no claim off uncited_premises (reasoning_debt and reasoning_report), and a checksum on it pins nothing. Artifact `source_reliability` (A–F) and `information_credibility` (1–6) on add_artifact: graded D–F or 4–6, a pinned source pins nothing, so a citation it documents reads cited_unverified and evidence evidence_unverified; each CitedSource carries `not_read`, `grade` and `pins_nothing`. Measured on the NS map: a DOCUMENTS from art:openai-lean-not-read marked not_read took req:claim-lean-check-passes off uncited on 0.90.0 and leaves it uncited now.
properties.name: A source named but not read never counts as citing, and a source carries evidence's grade so a citation reads no stronger than it allows
